data.name: AlDhani
data.gender_notes: AlDhani is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'dhana' which means 'to give'. AlDhani is a name for a giver, bestower, or generous individual. This name is mentioned in the Quran in the story of Prophet Yunus (Jonah) when Allah forgives him and restores him to his people as a sign of His mercy and forgiveness. The name AlDhani carries the meaning “Giver, Bestower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlDhani usually hope their child will grow to embody giver, bestower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reflecting Allah's mercy and generosity.
data.etymology: AlDhani belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver, Bestower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlDhani total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: الذاني
in_arabic.meaning: الذاني يعني الغني الكثير الذات في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: الذاني هو اسم مشتق من الجذر 'ذا' و'ن' و'ي' والذي يعني في اللغة العربية الغني الكثير الذات. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر اسم الله الذات في سورة يس آية 12 'وَلِكُلٍّ مِّنْهُمُ الذَّاتُ يَومَ القِيَامَةِ'. يعتبر الاسم ذا أهمية دينية وروحية كبيرة في الإسلام، حيث يرتبط بالغنى الروحي والذات الإلهية.

in_urdu.name: الذانی
in_urdu.meaning: الذانی مطلب ہے بہت سارے نفس والے
in_urdu.long_meaning: الذانی عربی زبان کی 'ذا'، 'ن'، 'ي' جڑوں سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بہت سارے نفس والے یا غنی۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم روحانی اور مذہبی اہمیت کا حامل ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان، جہاں یہ خدا کی ذات اور غنی سے منسلک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलधानी

in_pashto.name: الذاني

in_pashto.long_meaning: الذاني نوم د عربي ژبې د 'ذا'، 'ن'، 'ي' ريښو څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې ډیرو ذات لرونکي یا بډايه دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دوديز ارزښتونو او اسلامي ميراث په منځ کې روحاني او مذهبي اهميت لري.

in_english.name: AlDhani
in_english.meaning: Rich, wealthy, or one with a great soul
in_english.long_meaning: AlDhani originates from the Arabic roots 'ذا' (thā), 'ن' (nūn), and 'ي' (yā'), signifying 'rich' or 'wealthy'. It holds significant spiritual and religious connotations in Islam, relating to the richness of the soul and divine presence. Historically, the term has been referenced in the Quran (Surah Yasin, verse 12) as 'ذات' (thāt), implying a profound connection to one's essence and spiritual wealth. Across Muslim cultures, AlDhani symbolizes prosperity, spiritual fulfillment, and a deep-rooted faith.
